defects.symptom: Frontend build fails with TS2353 coordinate_status does not exist in type ServiceRecord
defects.root_cause: ServiceRecord interface in frontend/src/types/services.ts missing coordinate_status, coordinate_source, original_candidate_id, source_dataset, and fire_station subcategory added in Wave B1.2
defects.minimum_fix: Add missing properties to ServiceRecord and subcategories to frontend/src/types/services.ts

defects.symptom: Planning queries containing Mo Bus return Provider status: ok instead of itinerary
defects.root_cause: is_planning_query evaluated after is_transit_query and misses visit keywords, allowing transit keywords to hijack planning intent
defects.minimum_fix: Add visit keywords to is_planning_query and evaluate planning intent prior to transit intent

defects.symptom: Plan a rainy day in Bhubaneswar returns weather temperature instead of building an itinerary
defects.root_cause: is_weather_query evaluated before is_planning_query and checks rain without checking not is_planning_query
defects.minimum_fix: Ensure is_planning_query takes priority over is_weather_query when user explicitly asks to plan a day

defects.symptom: StitchNavbar hardcodes weatherSummary default to Bhubaneswar: 32C, Sunny
defects.root_cause: Hardcoded default prop in StitchNavbar.tsx line 36 risks displaying fake weather when unavailable

defects.symptom: test_wave_b1_1_first_batch_provenance.py asserts alembic_version == 0019, failing on current migration 0020
defects.root_cause: Hardcoded version check in historical Wave B1.1 snapshot test
frontend/src/data/staticTransitStops.ts was out of sync with data/transport/canonical/stops.json
defects.minimum_fix: Regenerate frontend transit fallback files via python scripts/generate_frontend_transit_data.py

defects.symptom: I have only 6 hours query generates a 2-day itinerary instead of 1-day
defects.root_cause: extract_multilingual_days does not handle hour-based queries (e.g. 6 hours), defaulting days to 2
defects.minimum_fix: Detect hour-based duration (e.g. 6 hours, half day) and return 1 day
